method: Same metadata set and source pairs for V3 and V4. V3 original input order and >=5 strict/normalized shingles; V4 changes review priority only; every raw measurement and summary checked against frozen V3 engine at main 01563bc7. Alternating-order direct engine timing; production V4 worker additionally checked. Source worker under unchanged preview caps. All 24 input permutations per four-candidate set guard against favorable input ordering. Curated candidate sets expose ranking, not live-search recall or statistical precision. Public source and authored counterexamples reported separately by kind. Frozen labels precede algorithm execution. Authored cross-path positives include exact bytes and known core fragments; negatives mean no labeled distinctive shared implementation, not proof of independent authorship.
